facts.fact: Lei n.º 45/X/2024 (Mapa III) appropriates CVE 369,781,930 for the Ministério da Economia Digital for budget year 2025.
The Ministério da Economia Digital vote falls from CVE 1,390,965,632 in 2024 to CVE 369,781,930 in 2025, a cut of 73.4%, with its capital line at zero.

The 2025 budget law's earmarked-revenue annex assigns the operators' communications contribution and the radio-spectrum fee to the Fundo de Serviço Universal e Desenvolvimento da Sociedade de Informação (FUSI), with counterpart expenditure of CVE 122,073,633 appropriated for 2025; the document shows the amount appropriated, not what was collected or paid.
